Ministry of External Affairs auctions nearly 300 diplomatic gifts

The Ministry of External Affairs is holding an e-auction of approximately 300 gifts received from foreign dignitaries. The collection, housed in the Toshakhana, includes luxury items such as Rolex and Cartier watches, jewellery, and daggers. This marks the first time the government has opened its diplomatic gift repository for a public auction.
